note: Calibration measurement infrastructure. ZERO real calls in this file. Upon Calibration GO, the script calibration_runner.py executes this plan under the authorized budget. Standards frozen in CALIBRATION_FREEZE_PREREQUISITES.json (sha256: 7aeeaddfb7c9ecbadd8a68952b50e7a614efdd6a1a119d49ca53e6c4c4c1344449).

measurement_cells.description: Each cell = (node, model, condition). Condition is 'clean' or a detection family. Per-cell target: 30 calls minimum.
measurement_cells.note: Conditions are applied at the TASK level. 3+3+2+2=10 (node,model) pairs x 4 conditions = 40 cells (not 48: r has 2 models, v has 2 models).

budget_envelope.note: Caps are ceilings, not completion guarantees. If a ceiling is hit, measurement stops and the PRIORS_REAL_V1.json is written with whatever cells completed. Incomplete cells are marked with their actual count and a 'below_minimum' flag.

task_panel.source: SAME source as the evaluation task panels (frozen200 / adaptive_benchmark), but DISJOINT task uids
task_panel.selection_rule: From the task source, exclude all uids in the evaluation panels. From the remaining pool, select tasks by frozen-seed random sample. The calibration panel SHA is computed and recorded BEFORE any measurement call.
task_panel.exclusion_rule: Tasks already used in: Formal campaign panels, net-benefit panels, or any prior experiment are excluded.
task_panel.note: Panel is frozen with SHA before measurement; task-selection code is part of this freeze.

per_call.prompt: Standard node prompt (same builders as production: eprompt/sprompt/vprompt)

per_cell.quality: For clean: compare answer to task gold. For fault conditions: compare to the expected repair outcome.
per_cell.tokens: P50, P90, P95 of total_tokens distribution
per_cell.latency: P50, P90, P95 of latency_s distribution
per_cell.distribution_tests: Shapiro-Wilk + D'Agostino K2 at alpha=0.01 (Bonferroni-corrected within cell)

switch_measurement.description: Separate from per-call service latency: measure the wall time of model START and model STOP.
switch_measurement.method: For each ordered model pair (from, to), run 5 start-stop cycles. Record start_wall_s and stop_wall_s.
switch_measurement.pairs: 3 models = 6 ordered pairs × 5 cycles = 30 switch measurements
switch_measurement.output: Per-model mean start_s and stop_s for PRIORS_REAL_V1

contention_probe.description: 2 tasks sharing the executor with known stub profiles; measure the delayed task's wall vs solo wall.
contention_probe.method: For each trial: run task A solo (record wall), run A+B concurrently (record A's wall). contention_ratio = (shared_wall_A - solo_wall_A) / solo_wall_A.

structure.per_cell: node|model|condition -> {q_success, tokens_p50, tokens_p90, tokens_p95, lat_p50, lat_p90, lat_p95, distribution_family, family_test_p, n_samples}
structure.calibration_provenance: per-entry: source, count, timestamp, SHA of the calibration panel, measurement script SHA
